description: Values for the Liferay DXP chart.

licensing.description: Licensing through the Liferay DXP operator.

activationCodeSecretKey.description: Key of the activation code in its Secret.

activationCodeSecretName.description: Secret that holds the activation code. Defaults to <name>-activation.

dxpVersion.description: DXP version the operator reports to the provisioning service. Defaults to the image tag.

enabled.description: Creates the LiferayEnvironment and syncs the license into the deploy folder.

environmentName.description: Human-readable environment name the operator reports to the provisioning service. Defaults to the namespace.

offline.description: Activates from an offline activation bundle instead of the provisioning service.

offlineActivationBundle.description: File name of the offline activation bundle in the environment's marketplace directory.

onlineActivationWorkflow.description: Argo workflow that submits the activation code.

clusterRoleName.description: ClusterRole the workflow service account is bound to.

enabled.description: Creates the online activation workflow and its RBAC.

serviceAccountName.description: Service account the workflow runs as.

ttlSecondsAfterCompletion.description: Seconds a finished workflow is kept before it is deleted.

userAccess.description: Service account a user submits the workflow with.

roleName.description: Role that allows submitting and watching the workflow.

serviceAccountName.description: Service account bound to the role.

tokenSecretName.description: Secret that holds the service account token.

secretName.description: Secret the license is mounted from. Defaults to <name>-entitlements.

syncInterval.description: Seconds between license syncs into the deploy folder.
